CloudRecord.title: CloudRecord
CloudRecord.description: A user-owned cloud backend record or studio preset synced in Bugti Editz.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the record owner.

title.description: Title or project name (1 to 120 characters).

category.description: Category or tag (1 to 60 characters, e.g., Preset, Asset, User Data).

payload.description: Backend data, preset description, or JSON payload (1 to 4000 characters).

/users/{userId}/cloud_records/{recordId}.description: Per-user isolated cloud backend records and synced studio presets.
